text: To lure someone is to attract them with something tempting. Here, theaters use special buckets to draw customers in.
Lampooned means made fun of in a joking way. Here, comedy shows teased the odd-looking bucket.
Tangible means real enough to touch and hold. Here, the bucket is something you can keep from the movie.
Memorabilia are objects people keep to remember an event or a movie, like a ticket or a poster. Here, popcorn buckets are the new memorabilia.
A novelty is a small, fun thing that is new or unusual. Here, the buckets are cute items fans buy for fun.
A collectible is something people want to gather, like trading cards. Here, it means special buckets and items fans save.
Lucrative means making a lot of money. Here, selling these items earns cinemas a lot.
Resident Evil is a scary movie series based on a video game, about zombies and a dangerous virus.
A courier is a person whose job is to carry packages or messages from one place to another.
A mutant is a living thing that has changed into a strange, scary form. Here, it describes monster dogs and rats in the film.
Infected means made sick by a germ or virus. In the film, the virus turns people into zombies.
Zombification is the process of turning into a zombie, a walking monster. It is a made-up kind of sickness in the movie.
To cough up money is an idiom meaning to hand over money, often when you would rather not. Here, fans pay $20 to $25 for a bucket.
Bespattered means splashed all over with something messy. Here, the bag looks splattered with fake blood.
Sold out means every item has been bought and none are left in the store.
Popping off is slang for being very popular or exciting. It is also a pun, since popcorn pops.
Revenue is all the money a business takes in from selling things, before paying its costs.
Going viral means spreading very fast online, as many people share it, like a germ passing between people.
A sandworm is a giant worm that lives under desert sand. These huge creatures appear in the movie Dune.
Fictional means made up for a story and not real. Arrakis is an imaginary planet.
To resemble something is to look like it. Some people thought the bucket looked like something silly and rude.
A meme is a funny picture or joke that spreads quickly online. The makers did not expect the bucket to become one.
A cult item is something a small group of devoted fans love, often because it is odd or hard to find.
Resale means selling something again after the first owner bought it. Some buckets sold for much more on resale sites.
Quintessential means the perfect example of something. Here, it means the most typical piece of a film, like R2-D2.
A keepsake is a small object you keep to remember a person, place, or event.
The credits are the list of names that scrolls at the end of a movie. After the credits roll means after the movie is over.
A status symbol is something that shows others you are important or part of a special group.
Obsessive means thinking about one thing all the time. Obsessive fans love a movie more than most people.
To signal something is to show it without saying it out loud. Owning a special bucket signals you are a big fan.
Hype is a lot of excitement and talk about something, often before it arrives.
Concessions are the snacks and drinks sold at a theater or stadium. The article defines them right after the word.
A high-margin sale is one where the seller keeps a lot of profit, because the price is far above the cost.
Tenfold means ten times as much. Sales grew to ten times what they were before.
To aver is to say something strongly and confidently, as if it were a fact.
Playful means fun and lighthearted, not serious.
Nostalgic means feeling warm and a little wistful about the past. Old movie references can do this.
Opening a can of worms is an idiom for starting something that causes many new problems. Here, it is a joke, since a sandworm bucket began this trend.
